params.body:
relay: a second screen signs what it asks

A desk app asked in its person's name, but the phone could not tell that ask from one an
agent made up: it kept no copy, so it said "this phone sent no such ask" and the write could
not be approved.

A linked screen now gives the relay its own Ed25519 key (POST /api/screens/key) and signs
each ask over the digest the gate seals: id, by, agent, words and at. The relay checks the
signature, the screen's key, the id and the time, and keeps the key and signature with the
ask. The phone lists the screens (GET /api/screens), takes a key as its person's after the
same code shows on both, and checks the signature itself; it may tell the relay
(/api/screens/trust) or unlink the screen (/api/screens/forget). The relay's word that a
screen is someone's counts for nothing on the phone.

The digest is unchanged, so the gate seals the ask as before. One vector is shared by the
relay, the gate and the phone.


The phone and desk side is bextrust/bextrust-android, branch ask-from-desk.
